title: Harness Configuration
description: Operator-authored configuration that controls how autoharness installs and maintains the agent harness in this workspace. Place at .autoharness/config.yaml before running autoharness install or tune.

nonEmptyRouteFields.description: F02FD596: matches a route object (escalation/stage/ship) that declares at least one non-empty model_family/model_provider/reasoning_effort field. Used to encode the both-present (legacy flat + nested per-role) escalation ambiguity as schema-invalid.

preset.description: Installation preset controlling the default primitive set and capability pack defaults

primary_stack_pack.description: Primary stack classification to prefer when multiple additive stack packs are present. Overrides auto-detected primary stack selection when set.

stack_packs.description: Additive stack classifications to treat as active for composition. Overrides detected stack packs when specified.

install_layers.description: Explicit artifact-class layers to compose. Use to clarify or constrain preset-derived composition. The 'overlays' layer MUST be present when capability_packs is non-empty and SHOULD NOT be present when capability_packs is empty.

capability_packs.description: Capability packs to enable. Overrides preset defaults when specified.

tool.description: Backlog tool to use. When set, overrides auto-detection.

directory.description: Root directory for the backlog (relative to workspace root). New installs default to '.backlog'; '.backlogit' remains valid for existing legacy workspaces. Used as a fallback default when no tool-detected directory is present in the backlog registry; it does not override a detected registry directory.

suffix_map.description: Work item type suffixes. When using backlogit, these are read from backlogit's project config and merged here. Operator values override auto-detected values.

root.description: Root directory for durable knowledge artifacts (relative to workspace root)

subdirectories.description: Subdirectory names within the docs root. Override to match existing workspace conventions.

continuous_learning.description: Configuration for the optional continuous-learning capability pack

directory.description: Repo-local directory for observations, instincts, and evolved learned artifacts metadata

capture_hooks.description: Enable environment-specific hook capture when the workspace and selected adapter support it

environment_adapter.description: Optional environment-specific capture adapter name, such as 'copilot-hooks' or a custom adapter

promotion_threshold.description: Minimum corroborating observations before an instinct is considered ready to evolve into a learned artifact

strict_safety.description: Configuration for the optional strict-safety capability pack. Defines action classification and approval rules for risky work.

enabled.description: Whether strict-safety action classification is active

require_approval_for.description: ActionRisk levels that require explicit operator approval before execution

graphtor_docs.description: Configuration for the optional graphtor-docs capability pack. Enables indexed local documentation search via the graphtor-docs MCP server.

sources_path.description: Path (relative to workspace root) to the graphtor-docs source index configuration file

binary_path.description: Explicit path to the graphtor-docs binary. When null, the binary is resolved from PATH or the default '.graphtor/bin/' location.

embed_model_dir.description: Explicit path to the local sentence-transformer embedding model directory used for offline vector search (written to .env.local as GRAPHTOR_EMBED_MODEL_DIR). When null, defaults to '<workspace_root>/.graphtor/models/all-MiniLM-L6-v2'.

model_routing.description: Model preferences for each routing tier and review-specific routes. Agent definitions use tier labels; this maps tiers and reviewer roles to environment-agnostic model identifiers and per-route configuration.

not.description: F02FD596/H2: the legacy flat model_routing.escalation and any nested <role>.escalation (stage.escalation / ship.escalation) MUST NOT both declare a non-empty field. This is ambiguous configuration -- fail closed at schema validation rather than let the loader silently pick a winner. See docs/decisions/2026-08-07-model-routing-hierarchy-dynamic-reload-deliberation.md.

tier1.description: Fast/cheap tier for low-complexity tasks (memory, docs, prompt editing). Accepts a plain model-identifier string (legacy) or an object with 'model' plus optional routing metadata.

oneOf.description: Legacy: plain model identifier string. E.g., 'gpt-5.4-mini'

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort setting for Tier 1 agents (e.g., 'low', 'medium', 'high'). Leave empty to use the model default.

model_provider.description: Model provider for Tier 1 agents (e.g., 'openai', 'anthropic'). Used when environment supports multi-provider routing.

model_family.description: Model family shorthand for Tier 1 (e.g., 'gpt-5.4-mini', 'haiku'). Resolved into agent frontmatter at install time.

tier2.description: Standard tier for routine tasks (orchestration, code writing, review). Accepts a plain model-identifier string (legacy) or an object with 'model' plus optional routing metadata.

oneOf.description: Legacy: plain model identifier string. E.g., 'claude-sonnet-4'

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort setting for Tier 2 agents (e.g., 'medium', 'high'). Leave empty to use the model default.

tier3.description: Frontier tier for complex tasks (planning, architecture, analysis). Accepts a plain model-identifier string (legacy) or an object with 'model' plus optional routing metadata.

oneOf.description: Legacy: plain model identifier string. E.g., 'claude-opus-4.8'

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort setting for Tier 3 agents (e.g., 'high', 'max'). Leave empty to use the model default.

orchestrator.description: Per-agent model override for the Orchestrator. When set, the orchestrator uses this model instead of inheriting from tier2. Accepts a plain model-identifier string or an object with routing metadata.

model.description: Model identifier for the Orchestrator. Optional — not consumed by agent frontmatter directly but recorded for documentation and tooling.

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort setting for the Orchestrator (e.g., 'high'). Leave empty to use the model default.

model_family.description: Model family shorthand for the Orchestrator (e.g., 'gpt-5.4', 'claude-sonnet-5'). Default: gpt-5.4.

stage.description: Optional first-class model route for the Stage agent (P-013.5, invocation-time model-routing enforcement). When set, Stage's invocation directive resolves to this route; when absent, empty, or any sub-field is unset, resolution falls back to model_routing.tier3 so P-013's tier taxonomy is preserved and nothing regresses.

model_provider.description: Model provider for the Stage role route (e.g., 'anthropic', 'openai'). Leave empty/absent to fall back to tier3's provider.

model_family.description: Model family for the Stage role route (e.g., 'claude-opus-5'). Leave empty/absent to fall back to tier3's family.

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort for the Stage role route when the environment supports effort controls. Leave empty to use the model default or fall back to tier3's setting.

escalation.description: F02FD596: optional nested per-role escalation route for Stage (P-013.6). When set, Stage's escalation directive resolves to this route in preference to the legacy flat model_routing.escalation; when absent, empty, or any sub-field is unset, resolution falls back per-field to model_routing.tier3 (never to the legacy flat route -- an explicit nested override never silently defers to the shared legacy route). MUST NOT coexist with a non-empty legacy flat model_routing.escalation (see the model_routing-level 'not' constraint) -- both-present is ambiguous and rejected.

model_provider.description: Model provider for Stage's nested escalation route (e.g., 'anthropic', 'openai'). Leave empty/absent to fall back to tier3's provider.

model_family.description: Model family for Stage's nested escalation route. Leave empty/absent to fall back to tier3's family.

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort for Stage's nested escalation route when the environment supports effort controls. Leave empty to use the model default or fall back to tier3's setting.

ship.description: Optional first-class model route for the Ship agent (P-013.5, invocation-time model-routing enforcement). When set, Ship's invocation directive resolves to this route; when absent, empty, or any sub-field is unset, resolution falls back to model_routing.tier2 so P-013's tier taxonomy is preserved and nothing regresses.

model_provider.description: Model provider for the Ship role route (e.g., 'anthropic', 'openai'). Leave empty/absent to fall back to tier2's provider.

model_family.description: Model family for the Ship role route (e.g., 'claude-sonnet-5'). Leave empty/absent to fall back to tier2's family.

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort for the Ship role route when the environment supports effort controls. Leave empty to use the model default or fall back to tier2's setting.

escalation.description: F02FD596: optional nested per-role escalation route for Ship (P-013.6). When set, Ship's escalation directive resolves to this route in preference to the legacy flat model_routing.escalation; when absent, empty, or any sub-field is unset, resolution falls back per-field to model_routing.tier3 (never to the legacy flat route -- an explicit nested override never silently defers to the shared legacy route). MUST NOT coexist with a non-empty legacy flat model_routing.escalation (see the model_routing-level 'not' constraint) -- both-present is ambiguous and rejected.

model_provider.description: Model provider for Ship's nested escalation route (e.g., 'anthropic', 'openai'). Leave empty/absent to fall back to tier3's provider.

model_family.description: Model family for Ship's nested escalation route. Leave empty/absent to fall back to tier3's family.

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort for Ship's nested escalation route when the environment supports effort controls. Leave empty to use the model default or fall back to tier3's setting.

escalation.description: DEPRECATED-LEGACY (F02FD596): flat, role-agnostic model route for telemetry-driven auto-escalation (P-013.6). Superseded by the nested per-role model_routing.stage.escalation / model_routing.ship.escalation, which take precedence when declared. Retained, unremoved, for backward compatibility (H9) -- resolves for any role lacking a nested escalation override, with a deprecation warning at verification time. MUST NOT coexist with a non-empty nested <role>.escalation (see the model_routing-level 'not' constraint) -- both-present is ambiguous and rejected; migrate fully to nested per-role escalation instead. When absent, empty, or any sub-field is unset, resolution falls back per-field to model_routing.tier3 so escalation targets deeper reasoning than the failing tier. If the resolved (model_family, model_provider, reasoning_effort) tuple equals the acting agent's own role route (e.g., a role route already pinned to tier3), resolution MUST be treated as ESCALATION_DEGRADED (same-route no-op) and fall back to the existing operator-halt path rather than silently "escalating" to an identical model.

model_provider.description: Model provider for the escalation route (e.g., 'anthropic', 'openai'). Leave empty/absent to fall back to tier3's provider.

model_family.description: Model family for the escalation route (e.g., 'claude-opus-5'). Leave empty/absent to fall back to tier3's family.

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort for the escalation route when the environment supports effort controls. Leave empty to use the model default or fall back to tier3's setting.

anchor_review.description: First-class anchor reviewer route used by adversarial, plan, and code review flows. Defaults to OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol where the operator environment supports it; skills must declare degradation when the route cannot be dispatched.

model_provider.description: Provider identifier for the anchor reviewer route. Use an environment-agnostic provider name; do not embed credentials.

model_family.description: Model family identifier for the anchor reviewer route. Default: gpt-5.6-sol.

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort for anchor review when the environment supports effort controls. Leave empty to use the model default.

alt_review.description: Optional alternate review route used for reviewer diversity when configured. When either provider or family is empty or absent, standard tier routing applies.

model_provider.description: Provider identifier for the alternate review route, such as google. Empty means no alternate route.

model_family.description: Model family for the alternate review route. Empty means no alternate route.

alt_doc_review.description: Optional alternate documentation-review route used by doc-review templates when configured. Empty provider or family means doc-review uses Tier 2.

model_provider.description: Provider identifier for the alternate review route, such as google. Empty means no alternate route.

model_family.description: Model family for the alternate review route. Empty means no alternate route.

ai_tools.description: AI CLI tool configuration used when generating workspace startup scripts (start.ps1 / start.sh).

exe_path.description: Path to the Copilot CLI executable (no arguments). Defaults to 'copilot', which expects the binary on PATH. Use a full path when copilot is not on PATH, e.g. C:\Tools\ghcpcli\copilot.exe

primitives.description: Specific primitive numbers to install (1-10). Overrides preset when specified.

overrides.description: Explicit overrides for template variables that take precedence over auto-detected values. Use sparingly — prefer correcting the workspace setup over overriding discovery.

lifecycle_hooks.description: Optional deterministic validation gates (pre_execution actions and pre_task_completion validation_gates). Validated in depth against schemas/validation-gates/1.0.0.schema.json by the config loader. Absent block means no gates run. See docs/gates-reference.md.

telemetry.description: Optional telemetry configuration (Phase 2 sink is not built in Phase 1). Validated in depth against schemas/validation-gates/1.0.0.schema.json by the config loader.
